name: Reply Guard
description: Keeps the longest version of each reply. While the site writes, every version is saved; if the page then reloads, cuts the reply off, empties it or hands back the previous reply, the longer one is kept as the final reply. Replies of sends that fail are kept too (⋯ → Reply Guard), and you can lock a reply so nothing shorter replaces it.

mode.label: When the page's reply is shorter than what was seen

options.auto: Keep the longer version (you can switch back)
options.ask: Keep the page's version, offer the longer one

minChars.label: Step in when at least this many characters are missing
minChars.help: An empty reply always counts, whatever this says.

ratio.label: …and the page's reply is under this % of the longest seen
ratio.help: The page's final reply is Markdown and the one seen while writing is plain text, so they never match exactly. 90 leaves room for that.

sameAsBefore.label: Catch a reply that is the previous reply again
sameAsBefore.help: When the page hands back the answer to your earlier message, the version seen while writing (if any) is used, else the message is marked.

keep.label: Saved replies to keep (⋯ → Reply Guard)
